supersede.why: One part only, so scripts/supersede_check.py --parts track=none,catalog=none,evaluate=none,integrate=partial is not a candidate. Elephant-Goldfish reviews one spec. It does not watch outside sources, it does not keep a deduped tool catalog, and it does not score tools on I0-I4. A local plugin someone could run is the integrate part at partial. It is not wired here. Do not adopt it in place of this repo. Do not add a watchlist row.
